title: Preserve base-unit meaning of stock count book and actual quantities
description: Close stock adjustment unit corruption: StockAdjustmentPostingRules.EnsureLiveMasterDataAsync checks only live warehouse/product. Approve compares BookQuantity to base inventory, computes ActualQuantity minus BookQuantity then overwrites d.Unit with product.Unit and posts difference unchanged. Explicit package/arbitrary labels are not validated. Keep count quantities and costs in established base units, reject mislabeled drafts and commitments; do not convert book or actual counts, infer a baseline or change signed differences. Preserve stale-count checks, positive/negative/zero difference behavior and atomic audit/reversal. Retain existing live identity/menu/customer-scope authority, transactions, source locks, controlled errors and audit. Reject before numbering or persistence, with zero header/detail/source/status mutations. No new permissions, schema, production access, external service or arbitrary SQL. Genuine SQL only on (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets and never drop/reset. Require safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine SQL/browser tests; accurately record blockers and do not claim whole-stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Create/update validate explicitly supplied detail units against the live product base unit before numbering, tracked replacement or persistence. This flow already measures quantities in base units: reject nonempty package/arbitrary units without converting quantities or costs; retain documented blank-unit fallback, trimmed case-insensitive base input and server-owned identities. A nonempty unit with missing base configuration fails controlled.

Submit/approve recheck stored effective units inside existing document/inventory locks before status or ledger mutation. Preserve permission checks, current inventory baseline and cost/quantity rules, source semantics and atomicity. Invalid requests change no document/detail/status/number/stock/movement. Historical read and reversal semantics remain available without newly introduced eligibility gates.

Meaningful unit/controller plus genuine isolated SQL exercise base/blank/case/whitespace, package and arbitrary invalid labels, edited product base before commitment, rollback and unchanged balances/audit, existing concurrency/posting/reversal regressions. Safe Release/full units required; record actual environment and full unique logs, no phase acceptance claim.
implementation_evidence: StockAdjustmentController:270 checks base inventory baseline;277-292 overwrites unit then posts difference. EnsureLiveMasterDataAsync has no unit comparison. ERP-507 protects numeric storage and ERP-355 stale counts, neither protects explicit nonbase labels. Reviewed all task history plus stock-adjustment docs.
